1349-3967-6854.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional nontoken creature with a coin counter on it.
1349-3967-6854.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature with a coin counter on it.
When the creature dies, Athreos's second ability and Host of the Hereafter's ability trigger.
Resolve the Host of the Hereafter trigger, putting a coin counter onto itself as well as +1/+1 counters if those were present.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 1.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Host of the Hereafter.
When Host of the Hereafter dies, it and Athreos's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Host of the Hereafter trigger, putting a coin counter and +1/+1 counters onto the other nontoken creature.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning Host of the Hereafter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 6.
Repeat.

215-527-7175.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 6 or greater.
215-527-7175.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {2}{G}{G}{G}{G}
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1308-4365-5660-6462-7368.description:
Activate Agonasaur Rex's cycling ability by paying {2}{G} and discarding it.
Agonasaur Rex triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Agonasaur Rex from your graveyard to your hand.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating four Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Agonasaur Rex ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat.

240-955-5470-6797.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

1329-6797-7340.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {U}.
1329-6797-7340.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Sewer-veillance Cam from your graveyard this turn.
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Sewer-veillance Cam from your graveyard by paying {U}.
When Sewer-veillance Cam enters, it triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Sewer-veillance Cam.
Sewer-veillance Cam triggers, untapping the mana-producing creature.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-2557-3899-4552-7329.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Mind Transfer Protocol.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

3446-3532-5078-7314.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Baxter triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

628-5147-7198.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Flitterwing Nuisance.
When Flitterwing Nuisance dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability
Repeat.

4222-6788-7170.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in hand with the mana to cast it, including at least one colored mana.
4222-6788-7170.description:
Animate Solar Array, if needed.
Cast Freed from the Real by paying its mana cost, attaching it to Solar Array.
Activate Solar Array by tapping it, adding {U} and causing the next artifact spell you cast this turn to have sunburst.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Solar Array.
Repeat from step 3 as desired.
Cast any artifact spell, triggering its sunburst ability an infinite number of times, either putting infinite +1/+1 counters on charge counters on the artifact.
4222-6788-7170.notes: This combo can be repeated whenever you want to cast an artifact spell. If needed as well, you can tap Solar Array for colored mana to use in casting that spell, assuming you do not want to continue the combo after the spell is cast.

2478-2866-3698-4986.description:
Cast Mishra's Bauble by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Scrap Trawler and Mishra's Bauble enter, Grinding Station triggers twice, untapping Grinding Station.
Activate Mishra's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Mishra's Bauble from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with a memory counter on it

3951-5703-6441-6646.easyPrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr
3951-5703-6441-6646.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker, triggering its ability, creating two tapped and attacking copies of Éomer.
Put all but one Éomer token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing you to get at least one Éomer trigger, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr triggers, causing you to exile the Éomer token.
Repeat each combat phase.

1174-1479-2907.notablePrerequisites:
You are able to play a land this turn.
You control two lands that can tap to produce at least {2}, one of which must enter the battlefield untapped.
1174-1479-2907.description:
Activate two lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Oboro Breezecaller by paying {2} and returning one of the lands from the battlefield to your hand, untapping the other land.
Play the land returned to your hand in step 2.
When the land enters the battlefield, Kodama and each Scute Swarm you control trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Resolve the first Scute Swarm trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers.
Holding priority, activate two lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Oboro Breezecaller by paying {2} and returning one of the lands from the battlefield to your hand, untapping the other land.
Resolve the Kodama trigger from step 7, putting the land returned to your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, each Scute Swarm you control triggers.
Repeat from step 6.

uses.n: Emet-Selch, Unsundered // Hades, Sorcerer of Eld

957-6333-6335.easyPrerequisites: Robe of Stars attached to Hades.
957-6333-6335.description:
Cast Time Stretch from your graveyard by paying {8}{U}{U}.
Holding priority, activate Robe of Stars by paying {1}{W}, phasing out Hades.
Resolve Time Stretch, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
During your first extra turn, Hades phases in during your untap step.
Repeat during your second extra turn.

1750-2793-4779-5131-5261.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Ugin's Nexus.
When Ugin's Nexus is sacrificed, it is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Pull from Eternity without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Pull from Eternity, putting Ugin's Nexus from exile into your graveyard.
Cast Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard by paying {5}.
Repeat.

2292-3542-5140.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{B}.
2292-3542-5140.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{B}.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {4}{B}, returning Palinchron from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Palinchron enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Palinchron, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

2060-3921-4929-5652.description:
Activate Genku by paying {3}{W}{U}, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Winding Constrictor.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{U}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite {C}, you may forego removing counters from Cryptic Trilobite.

997-2281-4549-5006.description:
Activate Relic of Legends' second ability twice by tapping Lurrus and Saffi, adding {G}{W}.
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Lurrus.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Lurrus.
When Lurrus dies, Saffi triggers, returning Lurrus from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Cast Saffi from your graveyard by paying {G}{W}.
Repeat.

1641-2034-4192-5115.notablePrerequisites: "Spirit" chosen with Ashes of the Fallen.
1641-2034-4192-5115.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Promised Kannushi, adding {C}{C}.
When Promised Kannushi dies, its soulshift ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Gemstone Array's first ability by paying {2}, putting a charge counter on it.
Activate Gemstone Array's second ability by removing a charge counter from it, adding {G}.
Cast Promised Kannushi by paying {G}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with at least two +1/+1 counters on it

3231-3693-4120.description:
Activate Walking Ballista's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Vigor.
Activate Walking Ballista's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Repeat as desired.
3231-3693-4120.notes: You may target a creature you control in step 2 to put +1/+1 counters on it due to Vigor.

2034-2043-4840.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Myr Battlesphere that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
The Myr Battlesphere token enters the battlefield, creating four 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar three times by sacrificing three Myr tokens, adding six {C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use Urza to make infinite copies of any artifacts you control.

500-851-2047-4772.notablePrerequisites: You control a nonlegendary artifact creature that does not have Mechanized Production attached.
500-851-2047-4772.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mechanized Production triggers.
Holding priority, cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying a nonlegendary artifact creature you control and creating eight token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
Resolve the Mechanized Production trigger, creating a token copy of the artifact it is attached to, and causing you to win the game.

675-1162.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is higher than or equal to an opponent's.
675-1162.description:
Cast Grab the Reins by paying {3}{R}, sacrificing Angelic Enforcer and dealing damage equal to Angelic Enforcer's power to target opponent with a life total equal to or less than your life total.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 or less life.

129-1912-3883-4893-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith by paying {U}, causing an opponent to draw a card.
Hullbreacher replaces the card drawn with you creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it to add {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding a mana of any color.
Repeat.

224-457-1767-5077.description:
Activate Urza by tapping Scaretiller, adding {U}.
Scaretiller triggers, returning Gateway Plaza from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Gateway Plaza enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Retreat to Coralhelm.
Resolve the Gateway Plaza trigger, choosing to sacrifice it.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Scaretiller.
Repeat.

2552-3263.description: Cast Vandalblast for its overload cost, paying {5} to destroy all permanents opponents control.
